edge.description: Logical routing configuration, not extra network hops or verified failover

steps.detail: The dev hostname belongs to an environment-specific profile, not a profile shared across environments.
Endpoint, route and origin group are configuration stages of Front Door, not separate proxy services.
The root reads the existing frontend ingress. Only one origin is configured; no regional replica/failover is established.
Access and WAF logs are disabled. Reconcile the generated edge hostname with the frontend origin allowlist separately.
